datePolicy: All external access dates are retained November 7, 2026 UTC as explicitly stated in sources.md. Undated publications remain undated; the Bexar form revision date is April 20, 2023, not a fee-validity promise. Authoring is not a source refresh. March 2027–February 2028 is a hypothetical future operating year, not confirmed demand, law, fees or market availability.
uncertainties: Pearl expressly excludes cottage-law vendors and closes applications in retained policy. No eligible alternative Saturday venue or its fees, insurance, attendance, tent/weights/cancellation/sampling terms were verified. One-event economics are conditional, not accepted/booked revenue.

Actual recipes, shelf stability/TCS status, allergen lists, yields and finished loaf weight untested. No comprehensive federal or claim-specific label review; no refrigerated/TCS expansion included in budget.

Annual inflation-adjusted cap, adjustment/proration timing and administrative-rule adoption history unresolved. Future legislation or rules may intervene; statutory cross-reference defect is not a loophole for excluded food.

Exempt-only sales-tax permit exception not expressly closed for this exact arrangement. Product/service classification depends on final menu and bakery-location test; no blanket cottage-food tax exemption asserted.
Bexar webpage $13 plus $1 conflicts with form $20/$21; actual launch-year payable DBA fee unknown. Training/DBA envelope is an allowance, not a fee quote.

Actual HOA/deed/lease documents absent. Municipal zoning non-prohibition is not private-property clearance or waiver of nuisance, address-specific occupancy, signage, traffic or building requirements.

All costs, insurance provision, selling prices, demand and labor efficiencies are hypothetical. Whole batches and consolidated baking dates assumed; separate bakes, refunds/spoilage, helper labor and custom work require recosting.
Square fee is a retained commercial domestic online/invoice rate, not a government-verified fee or future guarantee. Full-precision model and actual transaction rounding can differ by cents.

Labor pool is before personal income/self-employment taxes, benefits and startup recovery. Provisional 25% reserve is not a determined tax rate. No capital payback, guaranteed wage or demand is claimed.

Original research clean-session exception remains disclosed; later replacement captures do not retroactively cure it. No build, live availability, legal refresh or pixel/layout certification in this task.
editingContract: Only three new assigned files: en Markdown, data JSON and scoped batch25 notes. No Chinese locale, source edits, shared code/inventory/README/manifest changes, builds, network, publication, contact, registration or purchasing. No fabricated ratings, Review or AggregateRating.
